newsitem.title: GERMANY: Villeroy takes option for stake in Italy.
newsitem.headline: Villeroy takes option for stake in Italy.

text.p: German tableware and bathroom fittings group Villeroy & Boch AG said on Wednesday it had signed an option to take a majority stake in Italian ceramics group Ceramica Ligura S.r.l.

In a mandatory bourse statement Villeroy said it now had an option for a 70 percent stake in the Italian firm, located in Ponzano Magra. The move comes as 250-year old Villeroy & Boch struggles to swing back to profit after sluggish consumer demand and massive restructuring costs hurt performance.
The takeover of Ceramica Ligure "will help create a platform for Villeroy's tile business to show positive business developments," Villeroy said.
Ceramica Ligure last year posted sales of 46.3 million marks compared with Villeroy's 1.45 billion mark turnover.
